notes.title: Eos Released!
notes.content:
Eos Released!
Looking for a new puzzle game? Then we have the game for you! Eos, a game from our Singapore campus, has just released.

Eos is a first-person, 3D puzzle game in which you take control of a little girl who ventures into a tower. Confronted with a voice who seems to know an awful lot about her, he puts forth a series of trials to teach her about the past she never knew.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1571180/Eos/]Click here to download for free now![/url]
